# Informed mixed Boolean first-source study

Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

This is preparatory evidence for the next adopted common frontend unit after af26fad, not a new adoption, benchmark, proof or Issue completion. The author read the shared Boolean implementation, source profiles, previous immutable ordinary Boolean study, and parent implementation contract before authoring these small complete programs. No external model was called; deployed model identity and sampling settings were not recorded.

All first sources and schema-2 edition-2026 manifests are frozen before observation. Desired forms, the known finite T control, and deliberately unsupported future capabilities are distinguished. Observe with the existing prior CLI only, selected native kernel, at most two qubits; no builds or source snapshots. Native acceptance and source preservation are separate. The CLI still selects its existing hierarchy endpoint for sized commands; these diagnostics do not execute the proposed new mixed Raw API.

Independent expectations are written in projects.json before execution. Record every actual failure unchanged. A source mistake requires a separate named repair. Future Rust tests execute the public Raw API with native acceptance, independent distributions/exact phase action, effect and order checks. Output probabilities alone cannot show that an ignored measurement ran. Open quantum phase/reference observations and closed wrapper probes are distinct.
